source.title: 2026 Fantasy Football: C.J. Stroud among Justin Boone's top sleeper picks at QB
source.author: Justin Boone

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone sees Stroud as a late-round rebound candidate with a credible path back toward his rookie-season fantasy level.
takeaways.rationale: A healthier and deeper receiving group, improved backfield balance, a secure starting job, and a favorable quarterback schedule support a bounce-back case.
risks: The offensive line may remain a work in progress
Recent seasons were disrupted by injuries and inconsistent supporting-cast health

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone views Ward as an ascending fantasy QB2 who could approach low-end QB1 production if Tennessee's overhaul works.
takeaways.rationale: Brian Daboll's arrival, a substantially upgraded group of pass catchers and backs, and a favorable quarterback schedule create a better second-year environment.
risks: Limited rushing production constrains the ceiling
He must adjust to a new offense and receiving group

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone identifies Smith as a deep sleeper whose prior fantasy success makes a rebound plausible in New York.
takeaways.rationale: The Jets offer better offensive depth and a potentially solid line, while Smith has previously produced useful fantasy seasons and top-12 weekly finishes.
risks: He is coming off a poor season in Las Vegas
Recent performance makes a return to his earlier peak uncertain
